changeSet.author: mcpierce
changeSet.createView: SELECT DISTINCT c.comic_id as comic_id, (SELECT reference_id FROM comic_metadata_sources_v4 m WHERE m.comic_id = c.comic_id) AS reference_id, c.filename as filename, c.archive_type as archive_type, c.comic_state as comic_state, c.missing as is_missing, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT s.comic_id FROM comic_metadata_sources_v4 s WHERE s.comic_id = c.comic_id) THEN false ELSE true END AS is_unscraped, c.comic_type as comic_type, c.sort_name as sort_name, c.publisher as publisher, c.imprint as imprint, c.series as series, c.volume as volume, c.issue_number as issue_number, c.description as description, c.notes as notes, (SELECT c2.comic_id FROM comics_v4 c2 WHERE c2.series = c.series AND c2.volume = c.volume AND c2.cover_date < c.cover_date ORDER BY c2.cover_date DESC LIMIT 1) as previous_issue_id, (SELECT c2.comic_id FROM comics_v4 c2 WHERE c2.series = c.series AND c2.volume = c.volume AND c2.cover_date > c.cover_date ORDER BY c2.cover_date ASC LIMIT 1) as next_issue_id, (SELECT RIGHT (CONCAT('0000000000', c.issue_number), 10)) as sortable_issue_number, c.title as title, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comic_pages_v4 cp WHERE cp.comic_id = c.comic_id) as page_count , c.cover_date as cover_date , CASE WHEN c.cover_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cover_date)) END as month_published , CASE WHEN c.cover_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cover_date)) END as year_published, c.store_date as store_date, c.added_date as added_date, c.last_modified_date as last_modified_date FROM comics_v4 c
